title: O-RAN: Fixes to fragmentation/reassembly.
description:
Fix by moving fragment add/reassembly ahead of do{}while loop.

Code moved to separate function [dissect_oran_u_section()] to allow
same call on the incomplete sections.

notes.body: @daveysprockett If you add "Fixes #21544" to your commit message, hence this MR the issue will be linked/closed automagically. See the wiki [Development/SubmittingPatches](https://wiki.wireshark.org/Development/SubmittingPatches) under "Writing A Good Commit Message"

Pipeline is failing on these:

Total suggested replacements: 1

epan/dissectors/packet-oran.c:7877: trailing whitespace.

+

epan/dissectors/packet-oran.c:7883: trailing whitespace.

+

epan/dissectors/packet-oran.c:7894: trailing whitespace.

+

epan/dissectors/packet-oran.c:7896: trailing whitespace.

+

epan/dissectors/packet-oran.c:7911: trailing whitespace.

+

epan/dissectors/packet-oran.c:7924: trailing whitespace.
Good, this probably should have been a separate function a long time ago.

My reading of the spec (which I wish gave a detailed example) is that this data will not necessarily comprise a section, so will likely result in bogus malformed reports.  Section '5.5.4 Fragmentation considerations' is confusing, in that it is unclear which type of fragmentation(s) it is describing.  I read the last paragraph as referring to application layer, and it does refer back to the Figure that is specific to that method.

So I would probably choose not to try to dissect these fragments as complete sections. Perhaps there could be a preference (defaulted to off) that could enable this if you think it could be useful?

Apologies.

I have had some thoughts and think there are some more things required to
resolve this.   I'll attempt to update tomorrow.
